title: THE LAST MINUTE TURNS THE WORLD RED AND DROPS ASH
why: His answer g-48 (yes, ash and a red glow): the burn coming had only a sting and a red clock. In the last minute a full-frame red wash grows from nothing at 1:00 to 16 percent at 0:00 and up to 70 grey flakes fall and drift, fading in over 3 s, so the burn reads across the room on a TV in both windows. Drawn after the light, fog and flashes and before the HUD, render layer only, no sound, seed untouched.
now: The last minute of a raid slowly reddens the world and ash falls.
